item.title: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc
item.content: In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ledgerly.clock.ensure_utc` before arithmetic; it rejects naive datetimes with `BillingError("naive_datetime", ...)`. Follow the pattern in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py:current_period`.
